title: Marie Rose Sauce with Prawns
preamble:
2 tablespoons of good-quality mayonnaise

1 tablespoon ketchup

a pinch of cayenne pepper

sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

4 handfuls of cooked, peeled prawns
ingredients: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
cress or fresh flat-parsley leaves, to serve
method: Squeeze half a lemon into the rest of the ingredients and mix.
Serve with slices of the lemon and parsley on a bed of shredded lettuce.
